title: Independent review of RETEST-001 (confirmatory ImageNetV2 re-test at tuned lrs, common 20-epoch budget)
description: User approved RETEST-001 (2026-11-26); review follows the submit-then-independent-review protocol. Check pre-registration timing (task.json mtime, ledger add 03:54:48 UTC vs first run 20:55:31 local in grid_log.txt; analyze.py written 20:57:25 local while the grid ran), that analyze.py implements task.json exactly (12-test family A1-A4 pooled over levels as per-seed mean of per-level differences, B1-B8 per-head compression costs, paired t df 6 with t=2.447, detected/meaningful >=1.0 pp, Holm over 12, the write-up wording rule), that src/run_retest.py trains what task.json says (heads, lrs 1e-4/3e-4, 20 epochs, linear wrapper overriding run_grid.LR/EPOCHS, phase 'retest', test once per run via run_grid.test_run, no duplicated test rows after the smoke resume), recompute the family, checks (digests vs SEED-001, selected epochs, instability) and the key exploratory numbers (gain over lr 1e-3 runs, old-vs-new gaps, compression-cost differences) from runs/RETEST-001/results.csv and done.json plus SEED-001/MSWEEP-001 results.csv, and check overclaiming in report.md: test-set reuse, post-hoc 20-epoch budget, capacity confound, CI coverage, L080 'below 1 pp' vs CI upper bounds, the exploratory compression-tolerance reversal, and the 'withdrawn' wording for earlier claims. Read-only outside this folder; no training or GPU. Record a verdict.
acceptance: Verdict on RETEST-001 recorded with a note citing this report or the checks done
Confirmatory family and checks independently recomputed
Pre-registration timing and code-vs-spec match verified
